channel.title: The Munsif Daily - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Munsif Daily (munsifdaily.com)

item.title: Rahul Gandhi attacks PM Modi’s foreign policy, to skip all-party meet tomorrow
item.description: Leader of Opposition Rahul Gandhi on Tuesday launched a sharp attack on Prime Minister Narendra Modi, alleging that India’s foreign policy has become “compromised” and is being driven by personal considerations rather than national interest.

item.title: Did Israel Underestimate Iran Missile Power? Dimona and Arad Hit as 180 Injured in Massive Strike
item.description: Did Israel underestimate Iran missile power? Dimona and Arad hit, 180 injured as advanced Iranian missiles bypass defenses in major escalation.

item.title: Raghav Chadha flags misleading food branding in Raj Sabha, seeks crackdown on false advertising
item.description: Aam Aadmi Party (AAP) Rajya Sabha member Raghav Chadha on Tuesday raised concerns in the Parliament over what he described as "misleading branding and false advertising" in India’s consumer market, particularly targeting packaged fruit beverages.

item.title: Delhi Assembly Speaker regrets Atishi’s absence from House, AAP MLAs' remarks on Chair
item.description: Delhi Assembly Speaker Vijender Gupta on Tuesday expressed regret over Leader of the Opposition Atishi’s absence from the legislature’s proceedings and condemned her party MLAs for speaking ill of the Chair over the suspension of four AAP MLAs by the House.

item.title: BCCI bans match-day practice, tightens rules ahead of IPL 2026 opener
item.description: The Indian Premier League (IPL) 2026 is set to be played under stricter operational rules as the governing body, Board of Control for Cricket in India (BCCI), has introduced new regulations to improve team conduct and logistics during the tournament.

item.title: IPL 2026: Full list of injured and unavailable players
item.description: 19th season of the Indian Premier League (IPL) 2026 is set to commence on March 28 with defending champions Royal Challengers Bengaluru (RCB) taking on Sunrisers Hyderabad in the opener at M. Chinnaswamy Stadium.

item.title: Yakutpura Government Hospital NOC Delay: MLA Majid Hussain Questions GHMC in Telangana Assembly
item.description: Yakutpura hospital NOC delay by GHMC raised in Telangana Assembly. MLA Majid Hussain questions delay despite government approval for hospital project.

item.title: Bharat Gas Godown Tension in Mehdipatnam: LPG Cylinder Delay Sparks Clash Between Customers and Staff
item.description: Bharat Gas godown tension in Mehdipatnam Hyderabad as LPG cylinder delivery delays spark clash between customers and staff despite no official shortage.

item.title: Hyderabad Bike Stunt Case: Two Youths Arrested Near Lumbini Park and Secretariat for Dangerous Reels
item.description: Hyderabad police arrest two youths for dangerous bike stunts near Lumbini Park and Secretariat. Motorcycles seized, strict action warned against reckless riding.

item.title: Hyderabad Rains Bring Big Relief from Heat, Traffic Affected in Some Areas
item.description: Hyderabad heavy rains cause traffic jams and waterlogging in Miyapur, Kukatpally, Banjara Hills and other areas. Commuters face difficulties amid sudden downpour.
